title: ClearPath Standing Relief on Professional Services Projects Deposits
content:
Credit desk guideline for Professional Services Projects time-and-materials deposits: clients in good standing on ClearPath Managed IT Services carry a lower deposit percentage.

**Rule.** For a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise tier and whose ClearPath billing shows no late fee posted in the twelve months before signature, 10.0 percentage points are taken off the deposit percentage; for a client on one of those tiers whose ClearPath billing shows exactly one late fee posted in those twelve months, 5.0 points are taken off; for every other client no points are taken off.

**Window.** A late fee counts toward the twelve-month window when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the signature date, which is the day the deposit is invoiced, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Active ClearPath agreement on Professional, Premier or Enterprise? | ClearPath late fees posted in the twelve months | Points taken off the deposit percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | none | 10.0 |
| Yes | exactly one | 5.0 |
| Yes | two or more | none |
| No (no active agreement, or one on ClearPath Monitor, Essentials or Standard) | any | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a client on ClearPath Premier in active status with one ClearPath late fee posted eleven whole months before the signature date has 5.0 points taken off; had that late fee been posted twelve whole months before, no ClearPath late fee would fall in the window and 10.0 points would be taken off.
